subject: asp-es
title: ASP.ES.------SPT.D.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 84 ((AF)D-12). ASP-ES (aspect essence) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SPT-D (spectacle diversion) is the partner. From the subject: S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation). From S-ST: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TM: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: ALT-D (alternative definitions). From ALT-D: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). AFN (affinity negation) is on a dotted line from ALT-D.
